modmenu.summaryTranslation.chaosaholic: Level up. Unleash chaos. Survive it.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chaosahol: Level up. Unleash chaos. Survive it. Every experience level you gain starts a random chaos event: good, bad or just weird.
chaosaholic.announce.title: %s
chaosaholic.createWorld.toggle.tooltip: Every time you gain an experience level, a random chaos event starts: good, bad or just weird. Saved with this world. Operators can change it later with /chaosaholic on|off.
chaosaholic.command.on: Chaosaholic Mode is now ON for this world
chaosaholic.command.off: Chaosaholic Mode is now OFF for this world
chaosaholic.command.status.on: Chaosaholic Mode is ON in this world
chaosaholic.command.status.off: Chaosaholic Mode is OFF in this world
chaosaholic.command.scope.player: only the player who levelled up
chaosaholic.command.event.on: %s can happen again in this world
chaosaholic.command.event.off: %s will no longer happen in this world
chaosaholic.command.error.noTarget: %s has no valid target right now
chaosaholic.command.error.disabled: %s is switched off in this world
chaosaholic.command.error.modeOff: Chaosaholic Mode is OFF in this world. Turn it on with /chaosaholic on
chaosaholic.command.error.noEvents: Every event is switched off, so nothing can roll
chaosaholic.settings.title: Chaosaholic Settings
chaosaholic.settings.notifySound.tooltip: Play a sound when a chaos event starts. Danger warnings (TNT, anvils, lightning) always play.
chaosaholic.settings.notifyMessage.toolt: Show the title and the actionbar line when a chaos event starts. Boss bars and danger warnings always show.
chaosaholic.settings.screenEffects.toolt: Allow camera shake and other screen effects. Turn this off if motion bothers you.
chaosaholic.event.loot_pinata.desc: Mobs you kill drop extra random loot.
chaosaholic.event.loot_pinata.announce: Every mob is a piñata now!
chaosaholic.event.chest_from_sky.desc: A chest full of random loot lands nearby. It's yours to keep.
chaosaholic.event.double_xp.desc: Experience orbs you pick up count double.
chaosaholic.event.moon_jump.desc: Jump Boost III and no fall damage.
chaosaholic.event.tnt_rain.desc: Lit TNT falls around you, never right on top of you.
chaosaholic.event.anvil_rain.desc: Anvils crash down on marked spots nearby.
chaosaholic.event.mob_surprise.desc: A wave of hostile mobs shows up nearby.
chaosaholic.event.hunger_games.desc: Hunger III: your food bar drains fast.
chaosaholic.event.butterfingers.desc: Every few seconds you may drop the item in your hand.
chaosaholic.event.eternal_night.desc: Night falls at once and lasts until the event ends.
chaosaholic.event.lightning_storm.desc: Lightning strikes around you, never on you and without fire.
chaosaholic.event.sluggish.desc: Slowness II and Mining Fatigue I.
chaosaholic.event.bee_swarm.desc: A few angry bees come after you.
chaosaholic.event.blackout.desc: Darkness closes in for a few seconds.
chaosaholic.event.gravity_flip.desc: You float up and drift down by turns. It always ends softly.
chaosaholic.event.chicken_apocalypse.des: Nearby mobs turn into chickens until the event ends.
chaosaholic.event.tiny_world.desc: You and everything nearby shrink to half size.
chaosaholic.event.bouncy_floor.desc: Landing bounces you like slime, with no fall damage.
chaosaholic.event.swap.desc: You swap places with a random nearby mob.
chaosaholic.event.swap.announce: Wait, how did I get here?
chaosaholic.event.sheep_disco.desc: Rainbow sheep show up and start a party.
chaosaholic.event.random_teleport.desc: You teleport to a random safe spot nearby.
chaosaholic.event.screen_shake.desc: Your camera wobbles. You can turn screen effects off in the settings.
chaosaholic.event.glow_party.desc: Everything nearby glows, even through walls.
